description: Mentoring student developers in full-stack software development, covering modern frontend frameworks, backend API architecture, and relational/non-relational database design.
overview:
Delivering comprehensive, hands-on training in full-stack web and mobile software development for aspiring engineers in a remote-first environment.

Designing practical curricula, leading code reviews, and guiding students through building production-ready applications across frontend UI, server-side APIs, and database persistence.

Fostering industry best practices, effective debugging techniques, clean code architecture, and modern state management to bridge the gap between core concepts and real-world software engineering.
keyAchievements: Mentored and trained student cohorts in building end-to-end full-stack applications from database schema design to responsive frontend interfaces
Designed real-world project curricula covering REST API development, authentication, state management, and relational/NoSQL database integration
Conducted thorough code reviews and debugging workshops to reinforce clean code, performance optimization, and industry standards
Guided students through Git workflows, CI/CD basics, and collaborative development practices to prepare them for software engineering roles

description: Building and maintaining high-performance bible mobile application using modern React Native architecture.
overview:
Contributing to the development of scalable bible mobile solutions focused on performance, reliability, and seamless user experience.

Working closely with cross-functional teams to translate product requirements into clean, maintainable mobile interfaces while ensuring efficient data handling and state management.

Leveraging modern frontend tools and best practices to improve application responsiveness, reduce bugs, and support rapid feature iteration in a remote-first environment.
keyAchievements: Developed and maintained core mobile features using React Native and React
Improved data fetching and caching efficiency with TanStack Query
Collaborated with designers and backend engineers to deliver production-ready fintech features
Contributed to code quality through refactoring and reusable component patterns

description: Worked on full-stack and mobile features across multiple products during a fast-paced, collaborative internship program.
overview:
Participated in an intensive internship program focused on building real-world applications across web, backend, and mobile platforms.

Contributed to backend services using Node.js, Fastify, Prisma, and PostgreSQL while also building frontend and mobile interfaces with React, Next.js, and React Native.

Gained hands-on experience working in agile teams, shipping features under tight deadlines, and collaborating remotely with developers, designers, and mentors.
keyAchievements: Built and integrated RESTful APIs using Fastify, Prisma, and PostgreSQL
Developed responsive web interfaces with Next.js and React
Implemented mobile features using React Native and TanStack Query
Collaborated in team-based product development with regular code reviews
Improved debugging, testing, and deployment workflows during the internship
